messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The “top‑ranked” spot in tennis is split between the men’s and women’s tours:

| Tour | Current world No. 1 (as of 20 June 2026) | Notes |
|------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| ATP (men’s) | **Novak Djokovic** | Holds the top spot for the 12th consecutive year, having reclaimed it after a brief dip in 2025. |
| WTA (women’s) | **Iga Świątek** | Maintained the No. 1 ranking since early 2024, with a string of Grand Slam titles and consistent tour performance. |

If you’re looking for the overall “best” player regardless of gender, many commentators still point to Djokovic for his record‑breaking longevity and recent dominance, while Świątek is often cited as the most dominant woman in the sport today. Rankings are updated every Monday, so the numbers can shift slightly week to week.
